messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — AsterHealth onboarding has a SLO gap: 24h uptime at 98.4% vs contract 99.5%. Need incident window + credit estimate for customer packet. @rowan_sre @eli_ops
rowan_sre: on it. Initial look shows a spike of 503s at ~03:20 UTC tied to autoscaler lag. Pulling traces + host logs now.
eli_ops: their dedicated pool burst is tiny (1x). I can temporarily bump to 2x and run a cache warmup. Want me to proceed?
maria_cs: please do. Also we need the p95/p99 numbers, failed count, and any config cause so we can explain remediation.
rowan_sre: timeline draft: 03:17-03:26 UTC, ~240 failed requests, p95 jumped to 1.8s. Log snippet: ```503 | pool-driver | scale-miss | tx=abcd1234 | node=node-17```
eli_ops: scaled pool at 03:22, warmup kicked at 03:24. Recommend `scripts/warmup.sh --customer aster --top=50` to prime prefixes.
jamal_csm: I'll own the customer one-pager narrative. Need credit calc inputs: failed reqs, avg tokens/request, contract multiplier.
katie_pdm: Reminder: renewal call Tues. If we present remediation + a fair credit it reduces churn risk. I'll draft suggested concession language. :thumbsup:
maria_cs: also capture feedback from yesterday's enablement: they reported "slower responses during peak" verbatim. We'll include that.
eli_ops: quick credit calc provisional: 240 failed * 300 tokens = 72,000 tokens; at $0.0004/token = $28.80; contract multiplier 3x => $86.40. I'll confirm with billing.
rowan_sre: uploaded panels + traces to Drive: https://gdrive.redwood/aster/INC-2026-1023  includes p95/p99, histograms, host logs.
traffic-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-1023  audit bundle: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1023
maria_cs: next steps: Rowan timeline + screenshots by 2:30pm PT, Eli confirms billing calc & warmup results by 3pm PT, Jamal draft one-pager by EOD. Reconvene 4pm PT to finalize comms. Add blockers here.
rowan_sre: ack, will post timeline here when ready.
jamal_csm: ack, will drop an outline in 60m and pull verbatim customer feedback.
eli_ops: ack, warmup logs attached after run.
